body: A loaf and a first aid kit tied with barrier tape and twine. A paper tag with an evacuation number hangs from the bundle. The barrier tape has been cut and retied. The kit expired two months before the number's stamped date.
title: bread and first aid kit

body: The bowl has scratches inside, grouped in fives like a count. The spoon tip is worn sharp from marking. More marks than the posted number outside.
title: Bowl and spoon
